name: Stonebrow, Krosan Hero
description: A centaur dropped by a rift into Krosa who took up his axe in vengeance.

description_citations.text: Time Spiral: card flavor text (Time Spiral, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A rift drops Stonebrow into Krosa and he takes up his axe in vengeance.
timeline.quote: Moments after a fickle rift dropped Stonebrow in the waste of his beloved Krosa, he took up his axe in rage-blind vengeance.
